The '''Republic Science and Technical Center'''<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode219.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref> was a research facility on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="zbsb" /> Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="annual" /> it was used to examine the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] in an attempt to learn the secrets of its strong scales, which was impervious to any type of weapons, even lightsaber. When the beast gathered strength, it burst out of the facility, unhinging the massive doors at the front.<ref name="zbsb" />
